# FROZEN MISSIONS — the git object id every pinned path must have at the revision a run slices.
#
# `.github/julius-mission-pins.sh` refuses to provision a listed mission unless each path below has
# exactly this id AND the working tree agrees with that revision (the contract and the seed overlay
# are read from disk). A mission that is not listed is not frozen, and passes with zero pins.
#
# Mission 6 was frozen at 231369e6 on relay/julius-beta-qualification. PR #288 re-authored that
# history, so the freeze commit is not an ancestor of what lands; a tree or blob id is a CONTENT hash,
# identical wherever the content is, and these were measured equal at 231369e6, at #288's frozen head
# 15cf04d7 and at the follow-up branch. Change a line here only with a recorded founder decision to
# change the mission: this file exists so that the mission cannot drift toward being easier to pass.
#
# <mission> <repository path> <git object id>
